main.description: Builds an ordered feed skeleton from the same selection and cursor as app.gainforest.feed.getFeed. Each entry is only an AT-URI. A repost yields the repost record's URI. A burst or an audio day yields the sample URIs it references, newest first, so a page can contain more entries than its limit. Authentication is optional. When supplied, the AT Protocol service-auth issuer is the viewer. Anonymous requests that set params.following must provide params.viewerDid. Omitting params selects the global feed. The caller hydrates returned AT-URIs separately.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The request or the selected feed's parameters are malformed or semantically invalid.

errors.name: UnsupportedFeed
errors.description: The requested feed identifier is not registered by this service.

errors.name: InvalidCursor
errors.description: The cursor is invalid or incompatible with the selected feed.

errors.name: ScanLimitExceeded
errors.description: One account's run of observations or recordings is longer than the service reads, or reading it takes longer than the database statement timeout, so this page cannot be produced. Retrying the same request will not help.

errors.name: InternalError
errors.description: The service encountered an internal error.

feedId.description: Identifier of the feed algorithm to execute.

params.description: Algorithm-specific parameters. Optional for app.gainforest.feed.defs#activityFeed: when omitted, its defaults apply (filter all, following false).

limit.description: Maximum number of feed items to select. A burst or an audio day is one item but can contribute up to 20 skeleton entries. The selected feed determines the default and may enforce a lower maximum.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous request for this feed.

schema.description: Returns ordered, unhydrated feed subjects and an optional cursor for the next page.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Omitted when no later page is known.

feedSkeletonItem.description: One unhydrated record selected for the feed.

subject.description: AT-URI of the record to hydrate.
